numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income: Group revenue for 9 months 2025 = 76,664; 9 months 2024 = 67,977

numerical_claims.claim: Gross profit rose to EUR 31.549 million from EUR 29.237 million, while operating profit increased to EUR 21.282 million from EUR 18.942 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 31.549 million vs 29.237 million; 21.282 million vs 18.942 million
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income: Gross profit 2025=31,549; 2024=29,237. Operating profit 2025=21,282; 2024=18,942

numerical_claims.claim: Profit before tax reached EUR 16.186 million, compared with EUR 14.910 million, and net profit increased to EUR 13.158 million from EUR 11.862 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 16.186 million vs 14.910 million; 13.158 million vs 11.862 million
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income: Profit before tax 2025=16,186; 2024=14,910. Net profit 2025=13,158; 2024=11,862

numerical_claims.claim: Total comprehensive income was EUR 13.215 million, versus EUR 11.615 million, and basic and diluted earnings per share rose from EUR 0.031 to EUR 0.035.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income: Total comprehensive income 2025=13,215; 2024=11,615. Note 17: Basic and diluted EPS 2025=0.035; 2024=0.031

numerical_claims.claim: LNG regasification and related services generated EUR 43.640 million, compared with EUR 31.401 million in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 13: Income from LNGT regasification services 2025=43,640; 2024=31,401

numerical_claims.claim: Liquid energy products transshipment revenue increased to EUR 21.375 million from EUR 20.241 million, while consulting services revenue rose to EUR 7.507 million from EUR 3.961 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 21.375 million vs 20.241 million; 7.507 million vs 3.961 million
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 13: Sales of liquid energy products 2025=21,375; 2024=20,241. Consulting services 2025=7,507; 2024=3,961

numerical_claims.claim: Cost of sales increased to EUR 45.115 million from EUR 38.740 million, and distribution and administrative expenses rose to EUR 10.640 million from EUR 10.419 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 45.115 million vs 38.740 million; 10.640 million vs 10.419 million
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 14: Cost of sales 2025=45,115; 2024=38,740. Note 15: Operating expenses 2025=10,640; 2024=10,419

numerical_claims.claim: EUR 11.369 million of related depreciation was recorded in depreciation and amortisation in 2025, rather than under right-of-use depreciation as in prior periods.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 14* explains reclassification of FSRU depreciation with EUR 11,369 thousand impact

numerical_claims.claim: Finance income declined to EUR 1.520 million from EUR 2.644 million, while finance costs were broadly stable at EUR 6.616 million compared with EUR 6.692 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 1.520 million vs 2.644 million; 6.616 million vs 6.692 million

numerical_claims.claim: Operating cash flow more than doubled to EUR 76.331 million from EUR 35.637 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Cash Flow: Net cash from operating activities 2025=76,331; 2024=35,637

numerical_claims.claim: The increase included EUR 31.900 million from reclassification of financial assets to cash and cash equivalents.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Cash Flow notes EUR 31,900 thousand reclassification under operating activities

numerical_claims.claim: Investing activities used EUR 13.804 million, including EUR 9.751 million of capital expenditure, while financing activities used EUR 25.332 million, including EUR 8.622 million of dividends and EUR 10.451 million of loan repayments.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Cash Flow: Investing activities net cash flow =-13,804. Note 3 references EUR 9,751 thousand capital expenditure. Financing activities net cash flow =-25,332, including dividends paid=8,622 and loans paid=10,451

numerical_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents rose to EUR 54.398 million from EUR 17.203 million at year-end 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Cash Flow and Statement of Financial Position: Cash and cash equivalents 30-Sep-2025=54,398; 31-Dec-2024=17,203

numerical_claims.claim: Consolidated equity increased to EUR 167.721 million, while total borrowings declined to EUR 311.443 million from EUR 320.352 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Changes in Equity: Total equity 30-Sep-2025=167,721. Statement of Financial Position: Total equity and liabilities 2025=530,364 (equity=167,721). Borrowings total (non-current + current) 2025=311,443; 2024=320,352

numerical_claims.claim: Third-quarter revenue was broadly unchanged and quarterly net profit fell to EUR 4.570 million from EUR 10.403 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income: Net profit for 7-9 months (Q3) 2025=4,570; 2024=10,403. Revenue for 7-9 months 2025=25,581; 2024=25,363 (broadly unchanged)
